findings.summary: Opens with English letters and an index, no mention of risk/safety; reader feels it isn't for them
Cheapest option labelled 'הבחירה שלכם' though nothing was chosen; unclear if something was already picked
Minus sign in '−43 ₪' makes second option look like it loses money
7% return shown without saying it is only an example and could be lower or negative
Many numbers and bars with similar colours; legend hard to match
Long 'לא בחישוב' notes are hard to follow
White on black tires the eyes; grey lines pale
English fund names hard to read for non-English readers
